summary: Linn County, OR lookout on Tidbits Mountain: cab dated 1925 or 1926, removed or burned on site in 1967; a 2023 article describes a summit trail (temporarily closed that year by a fire), but no source describes what remains.

facts.status_note: Cab removed or burned in 1967; no source we read describes what remains on the summit
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Willamette National Forest

access.note: Summit trail described in a 2023 Bulletin hiking feature, which also notes a temporary closure during the Lookout Fire. No source describes the old site itself.

visit.trail_note: Tidbits Mountain South Trail, reached by a rough logging road from Blue River

notes_for_editor: Dates disagree across sources. Start: 1912 (Forest Lookouts) vs 1915 (register). Cab: 1925 (Forest Lookouts) vs 1926 (register, firelookout.com). The 1967 end is removed (register), destroyed (firelookout.com) and burned on site (Forest Lookouts, memo). Record kind ground and elevation 1580.4 m agree with sources. A search snippet described remnants scattered on the summit, but no page read confirmed it, so the story does not say so. The Bulletin article is a hiking feature and does not mention the lookout; its access claim covers the trail only.
